scope: Primary papers, fixed author source, and archived-artifact mechanism analysis; no model weights, real fit, or real inference.
year_rule: New methods must first appear in 2025 or 2026. Earlier papers below are exclusion records only.

pseudo_control.unit: Full 48-field final-FP32 bit-pattern group among P attack rows
pseudo_control.assignment: Sort whole groups by preregistered hash; admit group to AttackA if size does not exceed remaining 512-row quota; otherwise skip; all remaining groups go to AttackB.
pseudo_control.infeasible: Hard failure if exact quota is not filled; no seed or mapping search.
pseudo_control.sufficient_feasibility_condition: At least 512 singleton attack input groups guarantees greedy quota completion.
pseudo_control.preserve: Identical attack inputs are never split into conflicting pseudo classes; original Normal/Attack collisions are retained.
pseudo_control.audit: Record real-family by pseudo-class counts and any Scanning/OtherAttack collisions within full-input groups. Do not force real Scanning balance across pseudo classes.
pseudo_control.interpretation: One fixed nonsemantic partition; not a control for every meaningful subclass partition and not proof of a unique cause. Group selection is not uniform row sampling.

selected_next_probe.score: log(pAttack)-log(pNormal); for TF/TP pAttack=p1+p2 after fixed aggregation or algebraically equivalent log-sum-exp; never argmax or scanning-only score
selected_next_probe.forbidden_inputs: C/E family metadata cannot enter model/preprocessing/threshold inputs; family is evaluation metadata only.
selected_next_probe.cache: Rebuild both column and ICL KV per arm because target embeddings are baked into both.
selected_next_probe.cost_prediction: Same N/features/ensemble/model dimensions imply unchanged core KV tensor shapes; output columns and metadata differ; verify in synthetic tests instead of claiming exact file-byte equality.
selected_next_probe.supervision: TF uses existing archived P family labels; same row count does not mean equal annotation information to binary-only deployment.
selected_next_probe.optimization: No new optimizer, task fitting, retrieval search, or additional seed matrix.

sources.title: TabICLv2: A Better, Faster, Scalable, and Open Tabular Foundation Model

code.finding: max_classes defaults to 10; target-aware columns default true; same class capacity passed to column embedding and ICL.
Class values are one-hot encoded into configured class capacity, then linearly embedded.
At cache creation y_train is encoded and added before column transformer. Reusing cache skips it because labels are baked into KV. Only classes beyond max_classes trigger mixed-radix cache rejection.
Separate one-hot target encoder, fixed MLP decoder, cached target injection, max_classes guard, and slicing of outputs to requested classes.

sources.reason: Same P labels can affect pre-ICL column representation as well as ICL. A 3-class probe uses native capacity; this is a diagnostic intervention, not a new algorithm claim.

sources.mechanism: First forward obtains feature-weighted sample attention; a second forward predicts from selected context.
sources.reason: Query-specific context is a valid recent design, but it adds scoring, selection and multiple context construction. It cannot supply omitted network history; switching backbone confounds the current mechanism test.

sections: Section 7 attention-guided row selection and retrieval failure

code.finding: Documents scoring, query grouping, union-based context refits, batch dependence, cost, and reproducibility differences.

sources.mechanism: Last-ICL-layer query-context attention ranks support rows, query groups use retrieved unions, each group rebuilds a predictor; matched-size random contexts distinguish selection from size reduction.
sources.reason: Supports a matched-N control and shows class-composition correction is insufficient in at least one reported setting. Does not demonstrate a Scanning effect or TabICLv2 retrieval effect.

sources.earlier_version_note: An ICLR 2026 anonymous submission is also visible; no claim that May 2026 is first public disclosure across venues.

code.finding: Global per-class reweighting; DistPFN-T passes 1D P_test_avg into axis=1 reduction; code selects highest test AUC among ensemble settings.
Public formula agrees on multiplying class probabilities by global P_test_avg / training_prior, followed by row normalization.

sources.reason: With shared positive weights a,b, p -> a*p/(a*p+b*(1-p)) is strictly increasing. Same transform of C/E plus quantile recalibration preserves alerts. Separate query-batch weights change the deployment protocol. No benchmark gain is imported from the inspected script.

sources.reason: Claims a class-prototype comparison decoder without fixed output head for TabICLv2, conflicting with official Appendix A.4 and fixed MLP decoder source. The paper itself says single-variable comparison and code-level mechanism verification are incomplete. No author implementation was found in the checked primary text.
